reason: PowerSession v0.1.16 cannot record headlessly on the windows-pwsh runner: its stdout mirror thread calls WriteConsoleW, which fails with HRESULT 0x80070001 ('Incorrect function') and panics at record.rs:270 (cascading to terminal.rs:263 SendError), so only the asciicast header is written (0 output events, no usable GIF). This is a headless-runner limitation: PowerSession records correctly on a real interactive Windows console, but neither a ConPTY (pywinpty/zellij) nor CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE yields a WriteConsoleW-capable screen buffer on the GitHub runner's non-interactive session. See run logs.
